name: tombstone-op-type-contradicts-payload
description: The payload field is authoritative when an operation carries it, even when its literal op_type says the opposite (spec/fold.md §5.6): a delete-typed op whose body carries the declared field as false folds to false, and an undelete-typed op whose body carries the field as true folds to true. Only op_type "delete" and "undelete" are the tombstone strategy's recognized op types; that fallback applies only when the operation writes no value for the field at all.
